hmg_stereochemistry.interpretation: R assignment is explicitly carried by native full InChI and confirmed by issuing PubChem stereochemical SMILES; native CML alone is unassigned. Generic HMG CHEBI:58276 remains distinct. This does not assign absolute configuration to CHA.

limitations: Standard InChI can normalize proton positions and disconnect metal bonds. Exact atom charge distribution and native full CML/SMILES are separately retained.
Case normalization of invalid uppercase two-letter element types is explicit, checked against independent valid full InChI and issuing atomic identity; source bytes are unchanged.
A same-connectivity comparison does not establish stereo identity. Unassigned CML centers are retained as unassigned.
Native xrefs to neutral acid comparators do not establish identity of the native charged species.
No chemical identity proves the biological effect or delivery species in any assay. Primary source preparation and experiment scope must be cited independently.
